boxes.name: Standings
boxes.description: The maintainer's reality feed of current tournament standings.

contract.text: Standings file fields: v, resolved as ref/team pairs.

boxes.name: Team list
boxes.description: The team registry; registry order is load-bearing because the share-code encoding indexes teams by it.

boxes.name: User brackets
boxes.description: Entrant bracket picks, submitted through the Builder as a URL-safe share code.

boxes.name: Enriched data
boxes.description: Standings enriched with the team list into a display-ready model of each match's teams and results.

boxes.name: Scorer
boxes.description: Grades an entrant's bracket picks against the enriched standings into a bracket score.

boxes.name: Standings view
boxes.description: Renders reality as it stands, with no picks and no scoring.

boxes.name: Bracket view
boxes.description: Renders an entrant's bracket against reality and shows its score.

boxes.name: Leaderboard
boxes.description: Scores every entrant's bracket and ranks them.
